component.name: OpenFAKK2
component.summary: Source port of Heavy Metal: F.A.K.K. 2

description.p: OpenFAKK2 is a free and open-source source port of Ritual Entertainment's Heavy Metal: F.A.K.K. 2, built on the ioquake3 engine and checked against the retail game's behaviour.
It needs the data files of the original game (fakk/pak0.pk3 and fakk/pak1.pk3), which are not included.
